family: F*=(b(x)-2*1_(x=0)) y_(Mx), b=(-1)^q, q quadratic and q(0)=0
control_reuse: Arbitrary repeated controls in the program computing M; physical x remains independent of data y
data_reuse: Each terminal y_z can be shared by all histories reaching z; distinct states have distinct physical data coordinates
entropy_requires: Signed zero-fiber point-surgery histogram, not the unperturbed H=2r+k identity
influence_requires: Active controls stay at 1/2; inactive control i changes by (1-2*l_i)2^(1-n)
stopping_tree_requires: Zero linear phase at the flipped origin; query all nonzero address-column controls, then nonzero remaining quadratic polar rows on the origin-containing branch
terminal_reserves: Quadratic phases and point defects multiplied by one fixed data sign; every terminal retains one data influence and its full entropy
localized_boundary: No internal node has exact B_i>2Inf_i; bad-node sum w_v 2I(D_i)=0 at K=2
unsupported_extensions: two flipped points with incompatible quadratic gradients
linear terms at the flipped point for the same high-influence tree
